landing.hero.titleLead: Run the whole business from one
landing.hero.subtitle: Customers, sales, invoicing, projects, finance, and HR — sharing one source of truth. No tab-hopping, no integrations to glue together, no spreadsheets to reconcile.
landing.feat.sales.title: Turn leads into customers without losing the thread
landing.feat.sales.body: A pipeline that actually reflects how deals move — capture, qualify, and convert with ownership, activity history, and one-click handoff to a customer record.
landing.feat.sales.p3: Convert to customer in one click
landing.feat.billing.title: Invoices, estimates, and payments that reconcile themselves
landing.feat.billing.body: Send a branded estimate, convert it to an invoice, take the payment, and watch it post to your books automatically. No spreadsheets, no double entry by hand.
landing.feat.delivery.title: Projects and tasks that keep the work honest
landing.feat.delivery.body: Plan with milestones, run with task boards, log time against the project, and keep every file and discussion in one place the whole team can see.
landing.feat.books.title: Real double-entry accounting, not a money toy
landing.feat.books.body: A proper chart of accounts with journals, payments, expenses, and credit notes — so the financial picture is one you can actually trust at close.
landing.feat.people.title: HR that lives next to the work, not in another tab
landing.feat.people.body: Employees, attendance, leave, payroll, performance, and documents — in the same workspace as the customers and projects they serve.
landing.modules.title: One login. Every part of the business.
landing.modules.subtitle: Each module shares the same customers, the same people, and the same numbers — so nothing falls between the cracks.
landing.pricing.title: Start free. Grow into it.
landing.pricing.body: Spin up your workspace today on a free trial — every module included. Add seats and upgrade your plan when the business does, not before.
landing.faq.title: The short answers
landing.faq.q1: Is this really one platform, or a bundle of tools?
landing.faq.a1: One platform. Customers, leads, invoicing, projects, finance, and HR share the same data model and the same workspace — a customer record links to its invoices, projects, and tickets without any integration to set up.
landing.faq.q2: How is my data kept separate from other companies?
landing.faq.a2: Every record is scoped to your organization and enforced at the database layer — not just hidden in the UI. Your workspace is isolated by design, with role-based access controlling who on your team sees what.
landing.faq.q3: Can I start without talking to sales?
landing.faq.a3: Yes. Create your workspace, invite your team, and start working on a free trial. No credit card required to begin.
landing.faq.a4: It's real double-entry: a chart of accounts, journals, payments, and credit notes. Invoices and expenses post to the ledger automatically, so close is something you can trust.
landing.cta.title: Your business, finally in one place.
landing.cta.subtitle: Set up your workspace in minutes. Bring your team. Keep everything — and everyone — in sync.
landing.footer.tagline: The all-in-one CRM & ERP platform for modern businesses.
landing.footer.builtFor: Built for businesses that hate tab-hopping.
